title_en: EXCLUSIVE APARTMENT FOR SALE 1+1+BALCONY AT TOP SEVEN TOWER!
description_en: "TOP SEVEN TOWER RESIDENCE", designed by architect Marco Casamonti, located on Dritan Hoxha street near Zogut Zi. "Top Seven Tower" is an innovative and elite project positioned at a strategic point and with immediate access to all the main areas of Tirana. The distance of 1.4 km from the center of the capital makes this project a coherent and visionary investment. Also, the infrastructure, facilities, surrounding institutions and other similar investments in the area are obvious indicators that the whole area is undergoing rapid development. The apartment is located in the "Top Seven Tower" Residence. Super apartment 1+1+Balcony for sale! Information on the apartment 10/08. Gross area: 93.4m². Net area: 80.2m² - Floor 10 Organization - Living room. -Cooking environment. - 1 Bedroom - 1 Toilet - 1 Large Balcony The object is expected to be completed within the year 2031. For more information and a visit to the property, contact us.
